home.no_device_hint: Connect your phone over USB with USB debugging enabled.
home.unauthorized_hint: Accept the USB debugging prompt on your phone.
home.instructions:
1. Enable USB debugging in the developer options and connect your phone.
  2. Disable Battery Saver and screen timeout; set brightness and volume to 50%.
  3. Close running apps and background services.
  4. Click Start recording, unplug the phone and run your scenario for at least 5 minutes.
  5. Plug the phone back in to collect the results.

record.step_unplug_hint: The recording starts automatically as soon as the phone is unplugged.
record.step_recording_hint: Run your test scenario on the phone, then click Stop.
record.replugged_warning: The phone is plugged in: charging distorts the measurements. Unplug it until you stop the recording.
record.step_replug_hint: Battery data will be collected as soon as the phone is connected.
